text:
clara: Heads-up: We have the long-weekend deploy scheduled at 02:00. Because this touches billing-service we need two approvers or a prod-deployer with `dual-approve` flag. My MFA rotates at 01:55 so I can't press after that. Who's available?

ops-oncall: I'm oncall but kept my security key in the office. Can do approval if someone else presses.

jon: I can press but I don't have `prod-deployer` with `dual-approve`. people-ops, can you JIT grant `temp-deployer+dual` for ~3 hours? Prefer not to use breakglass.

people-ops: JIT policy requires an engineering approver + an exec approver for `dual-approve` grants on billing. We can fast-track with ticket and audit tags. Who's the exec approver?

ivy: I can be the engineering approver for this release. Release notes are attached in the ticket. Exec approver pinged: @release-manager can you confirm?

release-manager: I can approve but want artifact pinned and a rollback commit ready. Also want deploy-bot to require MFA check at press time and to log approver ids.

deploy-bot: preflight: artifact v3.0.5-billing sha=deadbeef \u2713
canary status: degraded in EU-2 (errors 1.8%) but staging canary healthy. policy: dual-approve required for service=billing-service. MFA required: Yubi or TOTP.

clara: Given EU-2 canary, let's pin the current artifact and postpone rollout to allow a short hotfix if needed. If we insist on midnight, we need explicit rollback plan.

jon: I'll take responsibility to watch and execute rollback if needed. people-ops, open ticket and grant `temp-deployer+dual` to jon until 05:00, approvers = ivy + release-manager.

people-ops: Ticket opened: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIT-9999. Granting `temp-deployer+dual` to jon 01:50-05:00 pending exec sign-off. Adding audit-owner=clara.

release-manager: Exec sign-off given in ticket. Can we pin artifact now? Command shown below.

clara: Pin and tag rollback before any press. Commands: 
```
ci-tool pin --env prod --artifact v3.0.5-billing --sha deadbeef
git tag -a rollback/v3.0.4-billing -m "pre v3.0.5-billing rollback" 0badc0de
```

jon: Pin complete. Rollback tag created. I'll run `/deploy prod billing-service v3.0.5 --canary 5% --dual-approve` once people-ops completes grant. Dashboards: billing QPS, latency, error-rate open. Pager rules enabled.

deploy-bot: action: awaiting both approvals (ivy, release-manager). MFA step required for final press.

ivy: Approved in ticket. I'm good to sign the approval when jon starts the job.

ops-oncall: Confirming I can respond to pages if things go sideways. FYI my machine has TOTP.

people-ops: Grant active. `temp-deployer+dual` assigned to jon from 01:50-05:00. Audit log: https://audit.redwood/claims/JIT-9999.

jon: Starting deploy now. Running canary at 5%. Initiating dual-approve flow.

deploy-bot: deploy-12345 started. awaiting approval signatures: ivy (pending), release-manager (pending). MFA prompt sent to both approvers.

ivy: Approved via MFA. Signed at 02:03.

release-manager: Approved via MFA. Signed at 02:04.

deploy-bot: canary rollout at 5% started. logs: https://ci.redwood/deploy-12345. Monitoring watchers: jon, ops-oncall.

jon: +8m canary looks stable in US and APAC, EU-2 shows slight latency bump but error rate unchanged. Proceeding to 25% after 15m smoke if stable.

ops-oncall: Will pause and escalate immediately if errors >1% sustained.

jon: Promoted to 25%. No regressions on dashboards. Proceeding to full after 30m.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All pods healthy. Final artifact pinned.

clara: Great job. Please document the JIT grant and approvals in JIT-9999 and attach audit links. We'll run a short retro tomorrow for the EU-2 canary latency blip.

release-manager: Noted. We'll review canary thresholds and consider stricter EU routing next time.

jon: Done. Ticket updated with links to audit log and deploy logs. Thanks everyone.

ivy: Thanks team. Enjoy the holiday weekend! :tada:
